name: 5100 Xizang Glacier Company Limited
summary: 5100 Xizang Glacier Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the production and sale of water and beer products in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Water Business and Beer Business segments. The Water Business segment manufactures and sells a range of water products through wholesales under the 5100 Glacial Water brand name; sells raw materials and consumables to associates and third parties; and leases production lines. The Beer segment offers various beer products through wholesales under the Highland Barley Beer brand name.
